title: Bob Lazar briefed on Project Looking Glass
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bob Lazar briefed on Project Looking Glass, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Bob Lazar briefed on Project Looking Glass

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, was briefed on something called Project Looking Glass. Michels does not say what the project was. He tells it twice in the same episode, and one version puts it in Nevada in the late 1980s, while the other gives no time or place.
